venues.name: Proving ground: gravel corner (left)
venues.notes: The BMP downhill left (bmp-gravel-corner) rebuilt flat on our own map (ADR 0008): the same centre line in the same course frame, 67 m of approach into a 124 degree left of about 32 m radius, 10 m of gravel on grass, dead level. Drills keep their gates; only the 14 m drop is gone.

venues.name: Proving ground: dirt strip
venues.notes: The south end of the proving ground's dirt strip (ADR 0008), facing north along it: 390 m of dead-level DIRT, 120 m wide (60 m either side of the start line), grass beyond. For straight-line drills (A03, A05, B01, B02).

venues.name: Proving ground: dirt ring
venues.notes: Near the north end of the dirt strip, facing east: a 15 m ring centred 15 m to the left (390, -150) fits with 25 m or more of dead-level dirt round it (the strip is 120 m wide), like the BMP dirt circle's bmp-dirt-ring (B05; parked C03, C06).

venues.name: Proving ground: dirt arc
venues.notes: 25 m before pg-dirt-ring's start, facing east along the ring's tangent, like bmp-dirt-arc (B06, B07).

venues.name: Proving ground: dirt strip, donut bale
venues.notes: The dirt strip 180 m from its south end, facing north up dead-level open dirt (60 m of it either side): room for a run-up, a bale to circle and an exit, clear of the strip drills (which end 30 m south) and the ring and arc (80 m north).

venues.name: Proving ground: gravel strip
venues.notes: The south end of the proving ground's gravel strip, facing north along it: 390 m of dead-level GRAVEL, 120 m wide, the same shape as pg-dirt-strip, for surface variants (ADR 0009).

venues.name: Proving ground: asphalt strip
venues.notes: The south end of the proving ground's asphalt strip, facing north along it: 390 m of dead-level ASPHALT, 120 m wide, the same shape as pg-dirt-strip, for surface variants (ADR 0009).

venues.name: Proving ground: snow strip
venues.notes: The south end of the proving ground's snow strip, facing north along it: 390 m of dead-level SNOW, 120 m wide, the same shape as pg-dirt-strip, for surface variants (ADR 0009).

venues.name: Proving ground: gravel lane, tightening right
venues.notes: gravel-lane-tightening on the proving ground's flat copy of gravel lane DR825 (shifted (900, 200) m, same heading), so its drill keeps its gates; 7 m of gravel on grass, dead level.

venues.name: Proving ground: gravel lane, opening left
venues.notes: gravel-lane-opening on the proving ground's flat copy of gravel lane DR825 (shifted (900, 200) m, same heading), so its drill keeps its gates; 7 m of gravel on grass, dead level.

venues.name: Proving ground: asphalt corner (left)
venues.notes: The gravel corner (pg-corner-left) built again in asphalt: same centre line, same course frame from this start, 10 m wide, dead level, the same barriers.

venues.name: Proving ground: snow corner (left)
venues.notes: The gravel corner (pg-corner-left) built again in snow: same centre line, same course frame from this start, 10 m wide, dead level, the same barriers.

venues.name: Proving ground: surface-change straight
venues.notes: A 12 m straight north from here: 122 m of gravel, 30 m of tarmac (a start line 8 m in), then gravel again, the same sequence as the BMP run-up and start line (bmp-gravel-runup) but dead level. D08's gates and zone fit unchanged.

venues.name: Proving ground: winding test road
venues.notes: The start of a 686 m winding gravel road heading east, 7 m wide, dead level: a linked S (left-right-left, radii 45/38/45 m), a fast right and left (55 and 50 m), then a right that tightens from 60 to 30 m. Tape 6 m beyond each edge.

venues.name: Proving ground: test road, tightening right
venues.notes: The gravel test road 487 m from its start, just out of the fast left, facing east down a 65 m straight into the closing right: about 60 m radius for 40 m, then 29 m for the last 25, 100 degrees in all, flat.

venues.name: Proving ground: test road, straight
venues.notes: The gravel test road 224 m from its start, just out of the linked S, facing east down its 105 m straight (7 m wide, flat) before the fast right.

venues.name: Proving ground: hill circuit, start line
venues.notes: wcusa-offroad-circuit on the proving ground's copy of the Off-Road Circuit's first 640 m (shifted (-80, -455) m, same heading, measured elevation kept), so its drills keep their gates.

venues.name: Proving ground: hill circuit, blind crest hairpin
venues.notes: offroad-blind-hairpin on the proving ground's copy of the Off-Road Circuit's first 640 m (shifted (-80, -455) m, same heading, measured elevation kept), so its drills keep their gates.

venues.name: Proving ground: hill circuit, kicker crest
venues.notes: offroad-kicker on the proving ground's copy of the Off-Road Circuit's first 640 m (shifted (-80, -455) m, same heading, measured elevation kept), so its drills keep their gates.

venues.name: Proving ground: camber corners
venues.notes: A 440 m gravel road heading north from here: a banked left (16 %), an off-camber right (10 %), a banked right, an off-camber left, all 90 degrees at 35 m radius, 8 m wide, tape 6 m beyond each edge.

venues.name: Proving ground: jump
venues.notes: A straight 280 m dirt road heading north from here; the kicker's foot is 150 m ahead (it rises 1.6 m over 10 m), the landing falls away beyond its crown, levels out 59 m past the foot, then 71 m of level run-out. Tape 6 m beyond each edge.

venues.name: Proving ground: rough track
venues.notes: A 320 m dirt track heading north from here, 6 m wide: smooth for 80 m, then 200 m of uneven ground through a gentle S, then smooth to the end. Tape 6 m beyond each edge.

venues.name: Proving ground: ford
venues.notes: A straight 182 m dirt road heading north from here, 6 m wide: 80 m of approach, then it dips 1 m into a creek, a 12 m level bed under -0.4 m of water (about 24 m of water along the road), and climbs out to 60 m of exit. Tape 6 m beyond each edge, broken by the creek.

venues.name: Proving ground: uphill hairpins (gravel)
venues.notes: The foot of a gravel switchback heading north: 40 m to the mountain face, then legs climbing about 7 % and three hairpins (left, right, left) of 11 m radius steepening to 16 % round their apex, 400 m and 32 m of climb to the plateau.

venues.name: Proving ground: uphill hairpins (asphalt)
venues.notes: The foot of a asphalt switchback heading north: 40 m to the mountain face, then legs climbing about 7 % and three hairpins (left, right, left) of 11 m radius steepening to 16 % round their apex, 400 m and 32 m of climb to the plateau.

venues.name: Proving ground: uphill hairpins (snow)
venues.notes: The foot of a snow switchback heading north: 40 m to the mountain face, then legs climbing about 7 % and three hairpins (left, right, left) of 11 m radius steepening to 16 % round their apex, 400 m and 32 m of climb to the plateau.
